QuestInfo.name: [Limina] Guard Captain Darknell
QuestInfo.0:
You reached the top of the waterfall, and fought off the Black Mage's Elites. 
The guard captain ambushed you, but Guwaru saved you.
QuestInfo.1:
As if the ritual started, the Genesis Crux starts shuddering.
It isn't until you defeat Guard Captain Darknell that Orchid tells you Neinheart's waiting to speak to you
aboard the White Spear Ship Deck in #bEnd of the World 1-1#k.
